articles.title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision
articles.summary: The collision leaves 32 people in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for.

articles.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
articles.summary: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.

articles.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
articles.summary: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.
